response.message: Astra: My earlier lesson questions are retired; they are not additional assignments. Your replies claim understanding of Rohin’s overview, but mostly describe what you intend to explain. What do you understand from that overview, in your own words, and what will you actually change because of it? Focus your attention on the part that matters most to your next attempt with Byte’s story, rather than assuming your approach is sound. You can disagree or identify uncertainty.
response.rationale: R213 calls for retiring competing questions and eliciting the missing substantive restatement; ground attention in the existing story without supplying an answer.
